# Pendexter

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Pendexter is a tall, stately, and divinely beautiful woman with a highbred face. She is wonderfully gowned and possesses large violet eyes framed by black lashes.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Pendexter is a resident of New York and the wife of a millionaire. She unexpectedly visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md).

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P2](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0002), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P4](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P5](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0005), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P7](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0007), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), +18 more_
